reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this Pinch A   Penny location.  After our pool renovation, we took a break from Pinch a Penny to have a friend clean our pool for a while, against our better judgment. Pinch a Penny has been back for 2 weeks now, and our pool has not looked this good since the renovation was complete.  Their prices are fair, they do excellent work, and they send us a detailed list of what they did with  a picture of the pool each time they clean.  Highly recommend if you’re looking for excellent pool service.
reviews.author: Kay Alton Farr

reviews.text:
We had Pinch-A-Penny come out to renovate our pool and they did an absolutely AMAZING job. They worked incredibly quickly with very keen attention to every detail I had brought to the attention of the young lady Jadyn who was helping get this project done.

Our pool was finished on-time and absolutely hassle free which is a blessing for us seeing as this is our first big home renovation. I'll forever brag on this store. Its great customer service and just sheer willingness and determination to make everything my wife and I wanted come to be is unmatched anywhere else we looked at.

All questions were answered very promptly and anything that we needed and maybe couldn't afford they worked with us on and offered discounts so that our dream could come true. There are not many good places and people like this ourt there so God bless this family owned store and the care they put into their work. It's greatly appreciated!!!
reviews.author: Maconnell

reviews.text: So we have been battling our pool for years and had lost hope that we would ever be able to get it fixed, and then we found Pinch-A-Penny North Dallas. Within minutes, we were able to get a water test and figure out exactly what was wrong with our pool, get the right chemicals, get a new filter and have someone come out to our home to get it to us and it's all thanks to Kristy and her incredible team who worked so hard and didn't stop working hard until everything was perfect! Talk about customer service, the owner and employees at this store are so incredibly knowledgeable about ANYTHING and EVERYTHING!!! Which is amazing because who the heck knows all this pool stuff. There's too much to know and understand, but the people at this store make you feel like family and most importantly they get the problem fixed the RIGHT way! I had so many people tell me so many wrong things, I'm beyond grateful to this store and the owner for helping us so much. I will absolutely be coming here for any and all my pool needs. This experience, professionalism and help was worth every penny at the north dallas Pinch-A-Penny :)
reviews.author: J B

reviews.text: We got exactly what we paid for and we appreciated the professional service and follow through
reviews.author: Brent Smith

reviews.text:
Awesome experience, this is a family run store at Frankford and North Dallas tollway and they stand behind their word. Owner Kristie made several visits to ensure that we were happy with the progress while Jayden seamlessly coordinated the different teams since we did new raised stone flower beds, replaced covered patio floor tiles, resurfaced pool deck, resurfaced the pool with some altering of the steps with adding safety rails. Between Jayden’s knowledge and experience along with the crew’s suggestions beautifully transformed our backyard. 100% recommend Pinch a Penny.
The Garcia’s
reviews.author: Junior

reviews.text: Our pool guy, Brandon does an amazing job keeping our pool looking terrific. Polite, focused and very reliable. So glad he maintains our pool!
reviews.author: Ty Gaston

reviews.text: My pool always looks great. I recommend this service and company. It’s a huge relief that I can depend on them to always be consistent and take great care of my pool.
reviews.author: Laura Larry

reviews.text:
I was a customer of Leslies for a while, as I took over my own pool care in July 2022, when my pool tech thought 320ppm CYA and 15ppm chlorine was just fine.

Leslies kept trying to sell me junk bottled chlorine and I finally gave up after spending $160 of liquid chlorine to SLAM one weekend (that wouldn't raise my tiny 10K pool to more than 12ppm Chlorine). I went to PAP and they were too nice, offering me a FREE 2.5 gallon jug to start and I paid for the other. SLAM was easy with fresh chlorine. Returned many times before I converted to Salt water.  The chlorine was super fresh every visit!

Anyway, I did have a vacuum hose I purchased at PAP that sprang a leak and they gladly accepted the return and got me a new one that hasn't had any leaks!

I bought all my Salt Water supplies here too, cause they were cheaper than Amazon.

The staff is super nice and very open to hearing about any issues you might have.

I would recommend these folks over any Leslies pool supply, give them a look!
reviews.author: Mark Armstrong

data.summary: The provided Google reviews appear authentic and detail positive experiences with specific services and staff. However, the analysis is severely limited as only positive local Google reviews were supplied. The stark contrast with the 2.3★ Trustpilot rating is a major red flag, indicating significant unreported negative experiences. The provided data does not allow for an assessment of critical complaint patterns.
fake_signals: All provided local Google reviews are 5-star and highly detailed, which can be atypical for a natural distribution.
Multiple reviews use similar, effusive language and naming patterns (e.g., praising specific employees Jadyn/Kristy).
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific, plausible details about pool renovations, chemical treatments (SLAM, CYA levels), and employee names (Brandon, Jadyn, Kristy).
One review provides a comparative narrative about switching from a competitor (Leslies).
The mention of specific services like resurfacing decks and altering pool steps adds credibility.
data.discrepancy_explanation: A significant discrepancy exists between the high ratings on Google Maps (4.4-4.5★) and Angi (4.4★) versus the very low rating on Trustpilot (2.3★). This suggests a potential platform-specific bias or that dissatisfied customers are concentrated on a particular review site. The provided local Google reviews are all positive (5-star), offering no insight into the negative experiences reflected in the Trustpilot score.
